reasons: The redline reverses the ownership direction as the rule requires: Customer owns each Deliverable and Vendor irrevocably assigns all right, title and interest, replacing the revocable, term-limited licence that fell into walk-away territory.
Vendor's pre-existing IP is left untouched (no edit to 14.3 / 13.2), and Vendor retains only the narrow use right needed to perform the Services, so the fix is targeted rather than over-reaching.

No new Customer Data sentence or joint-ownership deletion was needed because 14.1/15.1 already preserve Customer Data ownership and 14.4 bars joint ownership, so rule coverage is complete for this paragraph.

The failed minimal-edit heuristic (0.726 changed-character ratio) is expected here: reversing an ownership-and-licence allocation cannot be done without rewriting the clause; the added assignment-perfection sentence is standard and proportionate.
The comment is accurate, correctly states what changed and why, cites the playbook position, and reassures the counterparty that its background technology and existing licence-back are unaffected.
